root_idea.summary: The root centers on covering, concealing, or overwhelming, especially through abundant water or an engulfing force.
root_idea.development: The concrete image is water that covers what lies beneath. From it develop figurative senses of immersion in ignorance or hardship, concealment, crowding, and being overtaken; other extensions include abundance, generosity, daring, and inexperience.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed together with the singular citation form غَمْرَةٌ; the Quranic occurrence is its plural غَمَرَات.
The three occurrences are inflected forms of the same nominal lexeme and are presented under the singular dictionary headword غَمْرَةٌ.

senses.definition: An engulfing state or gulf that overwhelms and conceals; in Quranic usage, immersion in heedlessness, error, confusion, or obstinate attachment to falsehood.
senses.usage_conditions: Often occurs in the construction فِي غَمْرَتِهِمْ or فِي غَمْرَةٍ. The figurative sense preserves the image of water or a flood overwhelming what it covers.

senses.definition: The overwhelming pangs or rigors of death.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is the plural غَمَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ, referring to the severe distress accompanying death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of water: to become abundant, copious, or deep enough to conceal its bottom.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of water or a river.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To abound in beneficence or generosity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from abundance, applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overflow, rise over, cover, conceal, or hide someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject may be water or another covering force; the transitive construction may also describe a person concealing another or something else.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise above, surpass, or overtop others in eminence, excellence, or stature.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of being physically covered or overtopped.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Liberal, generous, or abounding in beneficence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person, especially in expressions concerning character or spontaneous bounty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To harbor concealed enmity, rancor, malice, or violent hatred; concealed hostility itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verbal construction غَمِرَ صَدْرُهُ عَلَى is used of enmity held in the breast.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The foul smell of meat, fish, or their grease adhering to the hand; to have such a smell on the hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the associated grease or residue that remains after handling meat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Inexperienced, ignorant, or lacking sound judgment through lack of experience.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe a person inexperienced in affairs, war, counsel, judgment, or work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To smear the face with غُمْرَة, a cosmetic or coloring preparation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form II usage describing application of the preparation to the face.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be deemed or regarded as ignorant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Passive Form II usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone or an animal water in a small cup or in small bowls.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may be doubly transitive when the recipient is given several small servings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To plunge into peril or conflict, engage someone in fighting, or contend in an altercation or dispute.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III; the construction may describe either entering the conflict oneself or engaging another party.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drink only a small quantity, less than enough to satisfy thirst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or animal drinking from a small cup or taking the smallest draught.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of livestock: to eat غَمِير, the green or succulent herbage described under that noun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form V usage applied to grazing animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To immerse, plunge, or become immersed in water or another thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VII; may be used reflexively of entering a submerged or engulfing state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Abundant, copious, or deep water; water or sea that drowns, submerges, or covers what enters it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used adjectivally of a sea or other body of water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse fleet, swift, or excellent in running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative comparison with the abundance and force of overflowing water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ample or full, of a garment or piece of clothing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dense crowd, throng, or multitude, and the pressing or jostling of people or water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions for entering or being among a crowded mass; the image is of people or water covering one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intensely dark, of night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival usage applied to a night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thirst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related expression may describe camels drinking a little or quenching their thirst only partially.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Drowning or being drowned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the expression مَوْتُ الغَمَرِ, death by drowning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small drinking cup or bowl, especially one used to divide scarce water among travelers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can denote the smallest type of drinking vessel and is associated with measured portions of water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Difficulty, trouble, distress, or the pressure and severity of an ordeal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In broader Classical Arabic it may describe the rigors of war, contention, or other severe circumstances; the Quranic death-pang usage is listed separately.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The main or thickest part of a contention, dispute, or battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction غَمْرَةُ الخُصُومَةِ or غَمْرَةُ الحَرْبِ for the central or most intense phase of conflict.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cosmetic or coloring preparation applied to the face, including preparations made with saffron or other described substances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can also denote the coloring substance itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person sound or penetrating in judgment when dealing with difficult matters.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet applied to a person; the reported form is lexically distinct from the noun for an engulfing state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Green or succulent herbage, especially growth overtopped or concealed by dried vegetation; also a specialized plant growth associated with بُهْمَى.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is used for several closely related kinds of low or newly appearing verdure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Much or abundant, especially when applied to property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival usage describing plentiful possessions or wealth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Immersed or in a state of being submerged.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial usage related to entering or remaining in an engulfing medium.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Palm trees that draw on a copious water source and do not require irrigation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural usage, reported as an attributed lexical application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Waste, desolate, ruined, or uncultivated land, and by extension a desolate house.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially land rendered unsown or unproductive by overflowing water, sand, dust, or excess seepage; it is contrasted with flourishing or cultivated land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most abundant, copious, or deep, especially of water; more surpassing or excelling than others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Comparative and superlative adjective, with the second use applied to superiority in stature or distinction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment or piece of cloth dyed with غُمْرَة or saffron.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Passive participial noun describing the resulting dyed material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose face has been smeared with غُمْرَة or a similar cosmetic.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine participial form in the cited usage; the definition states the cosmetic condition without restricting the lexical sense to a particular object class.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Overflowed, covered, concealed, or rained upon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Passive participle describing something overtaken by water or rain and thereby hidden or covered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Overcome, subdued, or oppressed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative passive extension of being covered or overtaken.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Obscure, unknown, or without reputation; of obscure lineage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative usage in which a person is considered hidden or surpassed by others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who plunges without consideration into peril, difficulty, or the thick of a dispute; an adventurer or risk-taker.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe reckless or courageous entry into danger and, in conflict contexts, one who engages in heated contention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Palm trees drawing water from a copious source.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural participial usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Drunken or intoxicated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative participial usage, as though intoxication had submerged the person's reason.
